items.title: New offices in Paris and Munich
items.summary: Anthropic opens offices in Paris and Munich as EMEA becomes its fastest-growing region, with run-rate revenue up 9x in the past year.
items.summaryZh: 本文来自Anthropic News，围绕“New offices in Paris and Munich”介绍模型发布方面的最新进展，重点涉及Anthropic、模型发布。下方为系统保存的原文正文。
